title: Inquest hears about P.A. man who died in police shooting
subtitle: Ryan Natomagan-Nelson, 26, died in July 2013
article: A coroner's jury is hearing details about the troubled man who died following an altercation with Prince Albert police last year.
Ryan Natomagan-Nelson, 26, was fatally shot after allegedly confronting officials with a knife on July 9, 2013.
The inquest began yesterday in Prince Albert and one of the witnesses was Natomagan-Nelson's former girlfriend Jasmine Schellenberg.
Schellenberg had been with Natomagan-Nelson for close to eight years. They had a daughter and lived together.
The couple had problems with drinking and with drugs and, Schellenberg said, Natomagan-Nelson also suffered from post traumatic stress disorder. At one point, they lost custody of their daughter.
After drinking on July 9, the couple began to fight.
Schellenberg then ran across the street and asked a neighbour to call the police.
Another witness says he heard two gun shots after that, although Schellenberg didn't hear those shots.
She didn't find out that Natomagan-Nelson had died until later that day.
Today, both the police and the man's mother will be called as witnesses.
The inquest, which could end with recommendations to prevent such incidents from happening in the future, is scheduled to run until Sept. 12.
